articles.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
articles.snippet: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
articles.snippet: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

articles.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
articles.snippet: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

articles.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
articles.snippet: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

articles.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
articles.snippet: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.
